description: Move a task to a new position within its list or to a different list. Can reorder, indent (make subtask), or un-indent.

destinationTasklist.description: Destination task list ID to move the task to a different list. Omit to stay in current list.

parent.description: New parent task ID (makes this task a subtask). Omit to move to top level.

previous.description: Task ID to position after (among siblings). Omit to place first.

name: move
